skill.name: note-cleanup
skill.description: Clean messy meeting notes into structured markdown summaries. Use when asked to organize meeting notes, extract action items, separate decisions from open questions, or turn rough notes into a clean recap.
skill.summary: Turn rough meeting notes into structured summaries with decisions, action items, and open questions.
skill.author: yaojingang

security_audit.summary: Static analysis found no suspicious patterns in the two scanned prompt and interface files. Manual review found no prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, executable code, network access, or filesystem access.

content.value_statement: Messy meeting notes hide decisions, owners, and unresolved questions. This skill turns rough notes into clear markdown summaries for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
actual_capabilities: Reads rough meeting notes before restructuring the content.
Removes duplicate points and obvious noise from notes.
Creates sections for summary, decisions, action items, and open questions.
Preserves important names, dates, owners, and context.
Produces a clean markdown recap from unstructured input.
limitations: It depends on the accuracy of the notes supplied by the user.
It cannot verify decisions or owners against external systems.
It does not transcribe audio or process meeting recordings directly.
It may ask for clarification when notes are incomplete or ambiguous.

use_cases.title: Prepare Team Meeting Recaps
use_cases.description: Convert rough team notes into a concise recap with decisions and next steps.

use_cases.title: Track Project Follow-Ups
use_cases.description: Extract owners, due dates, and unresolved questions from planning notes.

use_cases.title: Clean Client Call Notes
use_cases.description: Organize client discussion notes into a professional summary for sharing.

prompt_templates.title: Clean Basic Notes
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner cleanup for a short meeting note dump.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $note-cleanup to turn these rough meeting notes into a clear markdown recap with summary, decisions, action items, and open questions: [paste notes]

prompt_templates.title: Extract Owners And Dates
prompt_templates.scenario: Structured cleanup when follow-up tracking matters.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $note-cleanup to organize these notes. Preserve every owner, date, deadline, and dependency. Mark missing owners or dates as open questions: [paste notes]

prompt_templates.title: Create Shareable Recap
prompt_templates.scenario: Polished recap for stakeholders who did not attend.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $note-cleanup to produce a stakeholder-ready recap from these notes. Keep it concise, separate decisions from discussion points, and highlight action items: [paste notes]

prompt_templates.title: Normalize Complex Meeting Notes
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced cleanup for long notes with duplicates and unclear sections.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $note-cleanup to restructure these long meeting notes. Deduplicate repeated points, group related topics, preserve critical context, and list assumptions separately: [paste notes]

output_examples.input: Raw launch meeting notes with repeated comments about timeline, owner names, and unresolved pricing questions.
output_examples.output: A markdown recap with a short summary, confirmed launch decision, action items by owner, and pricing questions for follow-up.

output_examples.input: Scattered customer call notes containing requests, concerns, possible next steps, and duplicated feedback.
output_examples.output: A clean client-ready summary that separates customer needs, agreed actions, owners, and unresolved risks.

output_examples.input: Sprint planning notes with mixed tasks, blockers, dates, and informal side comments.
output_examples.output: A structured planning recap with decisions, action items, blockers, and questions that need clarification.

best_practices: Paste the full note set so context is available before cleanup.
Include names, dates, and owners exactly as recorded.
Review the final action items before sharing them with stakeholders.
anti_patterns: Do not use it to invent decisions that are missing from the notes.
Do not remove uncertain items without marking them as open questions.
Do not paste confidential notes unless your AI environment is approved for that data.

faq.question: What does this skill produce?
faq.answer: It produces a structured markdown recap with summary, decisions, action items, and open questions.

faq.question: Can it identify action items?
faq.answer: Yes. It extracts action items and preserves owners and dates when they appear in the notes.

faq.question: Does it work with very rough notes?
faq.answer: Yes. It is designed to remove duplicates, reduce noise, and organize messy notes.

faq.question: Can it verify meeting facts?
faq.answer: No. It organizes the supplied notes but does not verify facts against external sources.

faq.question: Is it compatible with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Should I review the output?
faq.answer: Yes. Review decisions, owners, and due dates before sharing the recap.
